pr_title: fix(common): titlecase pipe incorrectly handling numbers
pr_body:
Fixes that the `titlecase` pipe wasn't picking up numbers which meant that cases like `1st` would be transformed to `1St`.

Fixes #43459.
pr_comments: I've looked at the changes and the comment above this RegExp and I think we should not change it manually, so we can replace it with the `/\p{L}/u` version once we transition to ES2018. Instead we can try to come up with a RegExp that would leverage ES2018 capabilities (+ extra processing for a specific case that we handle) and transpile that to ES2015 version. @crisbeto what do you think?

That would be the equivalent to something like `/\p{L}|\p{N}/u`, but that makes the regex even more massive. See https://mothereff.in/regexpu#input=var+regex+%3D+%2F%5Cp%7BL%7D%7C%5Cp%7BN%7D%2Fu%3B&unicodePropertyEscape=1

It adds another 4kb to the regex so I'm not sure that the trade-off is worth it.

It's worth noting that the previous regex wasn't pasted verbatim from that link. The site transpiles `\S*` to `(?:[\0-\x08\x0E-\x1F!-\x9F\xA1-\u167F\u1681-\u1FFF\u200B-\u2027\u202A-\u202E\u2030-\u205E\u2060-\u2FFF\u3001-\uD7FF\uE000-\uFEFE\uFF00-\uFFFF]|[\uD800-\uDBFF][\uDC00-\uDFFF]|[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?:[^\uD800-\uDBFF]|^)[\uDC00-\uDFFF])*` whereas our regex had `\S*` stuck to the end of it. I'll keep the same pattern for now since it's smaller.

FYI regular presubmits went well, starting a [global one](https://test.corp.google.com/OCL:397651840:BASE:397665929:1632108986957:d090b4af) (internal-only link) to see if there are any targets that might require cleanup.
FYI presubmits (including a global one) are successful, removing the "presubmit" label.
